ios.desc:
Book Highlights is an app designed for readers who want to efficiently manage their books and reading notes. This app provides a straightforward solution for organizing your library and capturing important passages from your reading material.

- Book Management
Save and organize your book collection
Categorize books for easy retrieval

- Highlight Capture
Add highlights manually by typing
Capture text quickly using your device's camera

- iCloud Sync
Sync your library and highlights across all your Apple devices

- Kindle Integration
Import books and highlights from Kindle devices using "My Clippings.txt"

Book Highlights is designed to be a practical tool for readers, students, and professionals who need to maintain an organized collection of books and notes. Its straightforward interface and essential features make it an efficient solution for literary organization and reference.

Terms of use: https://sites.google.com/view/book-highlights-terms/inicio
